children: ”) (TSXV: TDG | OTCǪX: TDGGF) is pleased to announce that it has entered into a binding joint venture implementation and purchase agreement dated November 12, 2026 (the “
”) with its wholly owned subsidiary, TDG BC Assets Corp., and Freeport-McMoRan Mineral Properties Canada Inc. (“
”) enabling Freeport to acquire an initial 51% ownership interest in the specified area and lands comprising the Aurora West project (the “
”) located in the Toodoggone mining district of British Columbia (the “
”). The Company’s Shasta and Baker properties are excluded from the Transaction and will be retained by TDG.
Fletcher Morgan, Chief Executive Officer of TDG, commented:

This transaction validates our corporate strategy to work methodically on value-enhancing exploration, monetize assets, and recycle capital into projects we assess as offering the highest risk-adjusted returns. On closing, the C$110 million cash payment strengthens our treasury on a non-dilutive basis and improve our ability to advance Shasta. Our retained interest in the Aurora West Property through the joint venture also gives our shareholders continued exposure to its upside potential.

The Aurora discovery has demonstrated the exploration potential of the Toodoggone. Our agreement provides a framework to advance Aurora West and cooperate more broadly with Freeport, while surfacing operational synergies from its proximity to our flagship Shasta project. We look forward to building on that relationship to support responsible development in the district, to the benefit of First Nation rights-holders, our shareholders and all stakeholders.
Pursuant to the terms of the Transaction, TDG will undergo a pre-closing reorganization (the “
”) whereby it will assign its rights and interests in the Aurora West Property to two newly incorporated British Columbia corporations (the “
”) in exchange for all of the issued and outstanding shares of each JV Company (the “
”). One JV Company will hold two specified mineral claims in the Aurora West Property (“
”) and the balance of the Aurora West Property will be held by the other JV Company (“

”). Upon completion of the Reorganization and satisfaction of the other conditions of the Transaction, Freeport will purchase from TDG 51% of the outstanding shares of each JV Company, with TDG retaining the remaining 49% for C$110 million payable in cash to TDG at closing.
Upon completion of the Contribution, TDG, Freeport and each JV Company will enter into (i) a shareholders agreement (the “

”) setting forth the framework for, among other things, the governance and funding of each JV Company and the holding and transfer of interests in each JV Company, including the grant to Freeport of an option to acquire an additional ownership interest (the “
”) providing each JV Company with access to the Aurora West Property over certain roads located on TDG’s retained mineral rights.
Pursuant to the Purchase Agreement, Freeport will acquire a 51% interest (the “
”) in each JV Company for an aggregate cash purchase price of C$110 million.

Pursuant to the Shareholders Agreement, Freeport shall have an Earn-In Option to acquire an additional 24% (bringing its interest to 75%) in Aurora West JVCo and an additional 49% (bringing its interest to 100%) in ClaimsCo in consideration of (i) sole funding of an additional C$80 million of expenditures on the properties held by Aurora West JVCo (the “

”); and (ii) a cash payment of C$40 million to TDG for the purchase of TDG’s remaining shares of ClaimsCo. Freeport has committed to fund C$30 million of the Exploration Expenditure within three years following closing of the Transaction, including a minimum of C$15 million within the first two years (the “

”). Upon exercise of the Earn-In Option, TDG’s ownership interest in Aurora West JVCo will be 25%, and TDG will cease to own any interest in ClaimsCo other than a 2.0% net smelter returns royalty over the two specified mineral claims acquired by ClaimsCo under the Transaction.

TDG will not be required to make any contributions to the JV Companies during the Earn-In Option period. If Freeport elects to discontinue sole funding after funding the Committed Amount, or the Earn-In Option period expires without the Earn-In Option being exercised, Freeport will retain its 51% interest, and any unfunded portion of the Committed Amount will be payable by Freeport, and the parties will thereafter fund each JV Company

to their interests, subject to customary dilution provisions. A shareholder whose interest in a JV Company is diluted to 10% or less will surrender its shares in exchange for a 2.0% net smelter returns royalty (subject to certain deductions) of which Freeport can elect to repurchase one half for C$30 million. The Transaction is an arm’s length transaction.

Completion of the Transaction is subject to customary closing conditions, including the approval of the TSX Venture Exchange. The Reorganization is expected to be completed in December 2026, and closing is expected to occur five business days following the satisfaction or waiver of the closing conditions. Shareholder approval is not expected to be a requirement to complete the Transaction. The agreement is binding, subject to the satisfaction of closing terms and conditions.

TDG Gold Corp. is a mineral exploration company focused on advancing its gold, silver and copper projects in British Columbia, Canada. The Company’s projects include Aurora West, the Shasta gold–silver deposit, the Baker Complex, the Mets prospect and the Anyox copper project.
TDG’s strategy is to create shareholder value through disciplined, capital-efficient exploration, technical evaluation, resource growth and advancement of its mineral projects.
